title: DeepSeek's New Model Rattles Chipmakers and AI Rivals
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:01 - The China Show opens 
00:04:34 - CBA's Michael Tang on US 10-year yields nearing 5%
00:12:56 - DeepSeek's low-cost model deals a fresh blow to rivals
00:13:33 - SK Hynix, Samsung slide on DeepSeek threat 
00:28:09 - UBS' Lei Meng on why tech stood out in China earnings
00:37:41 - Louis Vuitton hit by social media backlash after suing Molly Tea
00:52:23 - China's oil inventories near operational stress levels
00:57:30 - First Abu Dhabi Bank's Gareth Nicholson on markets
01:03:36 - DeepSeek's latest model rattles Korean markets
01:07:50 - Analysts react to DeepSeek's latest model
01:14:02 - China targets mass adoption of autonomous vehicles by 2030
01:17:30 - Shanghai Enflame surges in trading debut
01:21:42 - SBI's Ashwini Kumar Tewari on opportunities for banks
01:25:50 -  Xi Jinping heads to India for BRICS meeting
